storyBuilder.title: Story Builder
storyBuilder.objective: Drag sentences into chronological order to rebuild the story.
storyBuilder.tip: PRO TIP: Look for transition words like 'However', 'Consequently', or 'Subsequently' to link sequences!

idiomMatch.title: Idiom Match
idiomMatch.objective: Pair the idioms with their true definitions and meanings.
idiomMatch.tip: PRO TIP: Don't take idioms literally! They usually describe a feeling or social situation.

speedSpelling.title: Speed Spelling
speedSpelling.objective: Spell the target word correctly before the timer runs out.
speedSpelling.tip: PRO TIP: Trust your muscle memory! Trying to think about every letter can slow you down.

accentShadowing.title: Accent Shadowing
accentShadowing.objective: Speak along with the audio. Match the speaker's pitch and rhythm.
accentShadowing.tip: PRO TIP: Focus on the musicality! Accent is about the 'song' of the language.

voiceSwap.title: Voice Swap
voiceSwap.objective: Switch between Active and Passive voice without changing the meaning.
voiceSwap.tip: PRO TIP: In Passive voice, the object becomes the star! Use 'by [someone]' only if needed.

directIndirectSpeech.title: Speech Shift
directIndirectSpeech.objective: Convert direct quotes into reported speech with correct tenses.
directIndirectSpeech.tip: PRO TIP: 'Present' becomes 'Past'! If someone said 'I am here', report 'they were there'.

tenseMastery.title: Tense Mastery
tenseMastery.objective: Select or place verbs in their correct chronological tenses.
tenseMastery.tip: PRO TIP: Look for 'Signal Words'! 'Since' often needs Perfect, while 'Usually' needs Present.

grammarQuest.title: Grammar Core
grammarQuest.objective: Identify and choose the correct form to complete the sentence.
grammarQuest.tip: PRO TIP: Read the sentence out loud in your head! Often, you can 'hear' if a rule is broken.

sentenceCorrection.title: Error Auditor
sentenceCorrection.objective: Scan the text for grammatical errors and apply the correct fix.
sentenceCorrection.tip: PRO TIP: Focus on subject-verb agreement first—it's the most common source of errors!

wordReorder.title: Syntax Reorder
wordReorder.objective: Arrange scrambled words into a grammatically sound sentence.
wordReorder.tip: PRO TIP: Adjectives usually come before nouns, and adverbs often follow verbs.

partsOfSpeech.title: Lexical Anatomy
partsOfSpeech.objective: Identify and label the correct parts of speech in the sentence.
partsOfSpeech.tip: PRO TIP: If it's an action, it's a verb. If it's a person/place/thing, it's a noun.

subjectVerbAgreement.title: Agreement Sync
subjectVerbAgreement.objective: Choose the correct verb form to match the subject.
subjectVerbAgreement.tip: PRO TIP: Watch out for 'distractors'—prepositional phrases that sit between subject and verb!

clauseConnector.title: Clause Linker
clauseConnector.objective: Choose the appropriate conjunction to connect the clauses.
clauseConnector.tip: PRO TIP: Use 'Because' for reasons, 'Although' for contrast, and 'While' for simultaneous actions.

questionFormatter.title: Inquiry Logic
questionFormatter.objective: Arrange words or choose forms to create an accurate question.
questionFormatter.tip: PRO TIP: Remember the 'Qu-A-S-V' rule: Question word, Auxiliary, Subject, Verb!

articleInsertion.title: Article Anchor
articleInsertion.objective: Insert the correct article (a, an, the) or choose 'no article'.
articleInsertion.tip: PRO TIP: Use 'The' for specific things we both know about, and 'A/An' for general things.

modifierPlacement.title: Modifier Map
modifierPlacement.objective: Place modifiers in the correct position to clarify the sentence.
modifierPlacement.tip: PRO TIP: Place the modifier as close as possible to the word it's describing!

modalsSelection.title: Modal Matrix
modalsSelection.objective: Select the modal verb that best fits the sentence's context.
modalsSelection.tip: PRO TIP: 'Must' is for strong obligation, while 'Should' is for friendly advice.

prepositionChoice.title: Position Pro
prepositionChoice.objective: Choose the correct preposition to complete the sentence.
prepositionChoice.tip: PRO TIP: Use 'In' for large spaces, 'On' for surfaces, and 'At' for specific points.

pronounResolution.title: Pronoun Pivot
pronounResolution.objective: Select the correct pronoun that clearly resolves the sentence.
pronounResolution.tip: PRO TIP: If there are two people, 'he' can be confusing. Use their names or clear markers!

punctuationMastery.title: Symbol Scribe
punctuationMastery.objective: Place commas, periods, or semi-colons in the correct locations.
punctuationMastery.tip: PRO TIP: Use a comma before 'and' only in long lists or between independent clauses!

relativeClauses.title: Relative Rail
relativeClauses.objective: Use relative pronouns (who, which, that) to connect the clauses.
relativeClauses.tip: PRO TIP: Use 'Who' for people and 'Which' or 'That' for things and animals.

conditionals.title: If-Logic
conditionals.objective: Complete the conditional sentence using the correct verb form.
conditionals.tip: PRO TIP: In 'Second Conditional' (imaginary), use 'If I WERE' even for singular subjects!

conjunctions.title: Logic Junction
conjunctions.objective: Select the correct conjunction to bridge the thoughts.
conjunctions.tip: PRO TIP: Remember 'FANBOYS': For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So!

skimmingScanning.title: Skim & Scan
skimmingScanning.objective: Scan the text fast to locate specific facts or main ideas.
skimmingScanning.tip: PRO TIP: Use your eyes like a radar! Hunt for capital letters or numbers first.

clozeTest.title: Context Mastery
clozeTest.objective: Fill the blanks by choosing contextually correct words.
clozeTest.tip: PRO TIP: Read the whole sentence first! Surrounding words reveal the needed part of speech.

findWordMeaning.title: Lexical Linker
findWordMeaning.objective: Find and match word definitions directly within the passage context.
findWordMeaning.tip: Context is your best friend! The surrounding words often reveal hidden meanings.

guessTitle.title: Title Tactician
guessTitle.objective: Read the passage and choose the most appropriate title.
guessTitle.tip: A great title captures the 'big picture'. Look for the most repeated themes!

paragraphSummary.title: Summary Sieve
paragraphSummary.objective: Select the single sentence that best summarizes the paragraph.
paragraphSummary.tip: Avoid sentences that only mention one small detail; look for the overarching idea!

readAndAnswer.title: Insight Analyst
readAndAnswer.objective: Read the passage and select correct answers to comprehension questions.
readAndAnswer.tip: Don't guess! The answer is ALWAYS in the text—you just have to find it.

readAndMatch.title: Semantic Bridge
readAndMatch.objective: Connect related facts and concepts from the reading passage.
readAndMatch.tip: Think about how concepts relate—is it cause and effect, or part and whole?

readingConclusion.title: Logical Finisher
readingConclusion.objective: Predict the most logical conclusion based on the reading text.
readingConclusion.tip: Follow the clues the author left! Where does the logic naturally lead?

readingInference.title: Subtext Sleuth
readingInference.objective: Identify implications in the text that are not explicitly stated.
readingInference.tip: The author's tone and choice of words often hide a deeper meaning.

readingSpeedCheck.title: Velocity Reader
readingSpeedCheck.objective: Test your reading speed and comprehension under a timer.
readingSpeedCheck.tip: Don't subvocalize (read out loud in your head)! Let your eyes glide over the text.

sentenceOrderReading.title: Structure Architect
sentenceOrderReading.objective: Arrange scrambled sentences into their logical paragraph order.
sentenceOrderReading.tip: Look for transition words like 'however', 'moreover', and 'finally'.

trueFalseReading.title: Truth Verifier
trueFalseReading.objective: Determine if statements are true or false based on the text.
trueFalseReading.tip: Be careful of 'absolute' words like 'always', 'never', or 'only'!

flashcards.title: Flashcards
flashcards.objective: Tap to flip flashcards and swipe through to master terms.
flashcards.tip: Speed isn't the goal—mastery is! Take your time to review definitions.

topicVocab.title: Topic Nexus
topicVocab.objective: Sort words into their correct thematic category bins.
topicVocab.tip: Sorting by topic builds semantic memory 2x faster!

prefixSuffix.title: Word Roots
prefixSuffix.objective: Build words by attaching the correct prefixes or suffixes to roots.
prefixSuffix.tip: Roots are the DNA of English! Master them to expand vocabulary rapidly.

wordFormation.title: Morpheme Mixer
wordFormation.objective: Combine prefixes, suffixes, and roots to form correct words.
wordFormation.tip: Suffixes change words from verbs to nouns or adjectives!

synonymSearch.title: Word Warp
synonymSearch.objective: Identify and match the correct synonym for the target word.
synonymSearch.tip: Focus on the core meaning, and filter out visual distractions!

antonymSearch.title: Polarity Pull
antonymSearch.objective: Identify and select the correct antonym for the target word.
antonymSearch.tip: Opposite meaning = Opposite pole! Match them quickly.

academicWord.title: Thesis Thrust
academicWord.objective: Identify advanced academic vocabulary matching the context.
academicWord.tip: Academic words are highly precise—pay attention to logical hints!

contextClues.title: Detective Lens
contextClues.objective: Use context clues to identify the meaning of unknown words.
contextClues.tip: Clues often hide right next to the redacted or highlighted word!

collocations.title: Pair Pop
collocations.objective: Match words that naturally pair together (e.g., 'make a decision').
collocations.tip: Collocations are words that naturally go together like peanut butter and jelly!

phrasalVerbs.title: Verb Vault
phrasalVerbs.objective: Select correct prepositions or particles to complete phrasal verbs.
phrasalVerbs.tip: Particles change everything! 'Turn up' has a completely different meaning than 'turn down'.

idioms.title: Emojify
idioms.objective: Decode emojis and phrases into correct English idioms.
idioms.tip: Idioms are colorful cultural keys! Don't take them literally.

contextualUsage.title: Usage Unfold
contextualUsage.objective: Identify the word that fits perfectly in the context of the sentence.
contextualUsage.tip: Nuance is key! Choose the word that logically belongs in the sentence.

sentenceBuilder.title: Sentence Architect
sentenceBuilder.objective: Arrange sentence fragments into a grammatically correct order.
sentenceBuilder.tip: PRO TIP: Start with the 'Who' or 'What', then find the 'Action'!

completeSentence.title: Fragment Fixer
completeSentence.objective: Complete fragments by choosing or writing correct missing parts.
completeSentence.tip: PRO TIP: A complete sentence needs both a Subject and a Verb at minimum!

describeSituationWriting.title: Context Scribe
describeSituationWriting.objective: Write a descriptive paragraph based on the scenario or image.
describeSituationWriting.tip: PRO TIP: Use sensory words! Describe what is seen, heard, or felt.

fixTheSentence.title: Clarity Editor
fixTheSentence.objective: Scan the sentence and correct grammatical and stylistic errors.
fixTheSentence.tip: PRO TIP: Read it out loud in your head! If it sounds clumsy, revise it.

shortAnswerWriting.title: Briefing Pro
shortAnswerWriting.objective: Write a brief, concise, and direct response to the prompt.
shortAnswerWriting.tip: PRO TIP: Get straight to the point! Keep it short and accurate.

opinionWriting.title: Vocal Pen
opinionWriting.objective: Write a brief statement expressing and defending your opinion.
opinionWriting.tip: PRO TIP: Use transitions like 'In my view', 'For instance', or 'Consequently'.

dailyJournal.title: Daily Chronicler
dailyJournal.objective: Write a short personal journal reflection based on the prompt.
dailyJournal.tip: PRO TIP: Use sequential markers like 'First', 'Later', and 'Eventually'.

summarizeStoryWriting.title: Essence Extractor
summarizeStoryWriting.objective: Read the story and draft a concise, objective summary.
summarizeStoryWriting.tip: PRO TIP: Identify the 'Who', 'What', 'Where', and 'Why' of the plot.

writingEmail.title: Email Expert
writingEmail.objective: Compose a professional and contextually appropriate email.
writingEmail.tip: PRO TIP: Clear subject lines and direct greetings set the professional tone.

correctionWriting.title: Deep Editor
correctionWriting.objective: Polish and rewrite the paragraph to fix all structural issues.
correctionWriting.tip: PRO TIP: Look for repetitive words and swap them for rich synonyms!

essayDrafting.title: Essay Architect
essayDrafting.objective: Draft a structured essay with an introduction, body, and conclusion.
essayDrafting.tip: PRO TIP: Ensure each body paragraph has a clear topic sentence.

ambientId.title: Spatial Anchor
ambientId.objective: Listen to the background audio and identify the scenario location.
ambientId.tip: Focus on ambient sounds like footsteps, echoes, wind, or hums!

audioFillBlanks.title: Ink Decoder
audioFillBlanks.objective: Listen to the audio feed and type the missing words in the transcript.
audioFillBlanks.tip: Listen carefully to short helper words like 'a', 'the', 'in', or 'at'!

audioMultipleChoice.title: Sonic Satellites
audioMultipleChoice.objective: Listen to the audio passage and select the correct answer.
audioMultipleChoice.tip: Filter out noise and focus entirely on the speaker's main message.

audioSentenceOrder.title: Timeline Scrubber
audioSentenceOrder.objective: Listen and arrange the spoken segments in their correct chronological order.
audioSentenceOrder.tip: Logical connectors like 'first', 'then', and 'after that' are your clues.

audioTrueFalse.title: Signal Validator
audioTrueFalse.objective: Listen to the speaker and verify if the claim is true or false.
audioTrueFalse.tip: Be careful of exact details—names, numbers, and dates must match perfectly.

detailSpotlight.title: Spotlight Search
detailSpotlight.objective: Listen for specific names, numbers, or details within the passage.
detailSpotlight.tip: Note details as you listen—rushing to answer from memory can be tricky!

emotionRecognition.title: Sentiment Prober
emotionRecognition.objective: Identify the speaker's emotional state from their pitch and tone.
emotionRecognition.tip: Rhythm, volume spikes, and sighing express more than literal words.

fastSpeechDecoder.title: Nuance Calibrator
fastSpeechDecoder.objective: Decode rapid native speech by picking out word boundaries.
fastSpeechDecoder.tip: Focus on stressed syllables—they carry the core meaning in fast speech.

listeningInference.title: Inference Lens
listeningInference.objective: Infer implications in the spoken passage that are not explicitly stated.
listeningInference.tip: Listen for hesitation or sarcasm—voice inflections hold crucial keys.

soundImageMatch.title: Thematic Linker
soundImageMatch.objective: Listen to the audio sound and match it with the correct visual image.
soundImageMatch.tip: Try to describe the sound in one word before selecting your choice.

minimalPairs.title: Minimal Distinctions
minimalPairs.objective: Distinguish between words with minor sound differences (e.g., live vs leave).
minimalPairs.tip: PRO TIP: Pay attention to mouth shape and vowel duration!

intonationMimic.title: Pitch Mimic
intonationMimic.objective: Repeat the sentence mimicking the rising and falling native pitch curves.
intonationMimic.tip: PRO TIP: Exaggerate the rising pitch at the end of questions!

syllableStress.title: Stress Spotter
syllableStress.objective: Pinpoint and highlight the primary stressed syllable in the word.
syllableStress.tip: PRO TIP: Stressed syllables are louder, higher in pitch, and have longer vowels.

wordLinking.title: Fluid Flow
wordLinking.objective: Master word boundary linking to speak with native fluid rhythms.
wordLinking.tip: PRO TIP: Push end consonants directly into starting vowels of the next word.

shadowingChallenge.title: Speed Shadow
shadowingChallenge.objective: Speak along with the native model with minimal delay to train fluency.
shadowingChallenge.tip: PRO TIP: Don't wait—begin speaking as soon as you hear the first sound!

vowelDistinction.title: Vowel Vortex
vowelDistinction.objective: Isolate and master differences between subtle English vowel phonemes.
vowelDistinction.tip: PRO TIP: Drop your jaw slightly lower for vowels like /æ/ than for /ɛ/.

consonantClarity.title: Clear Consonants
consonantClarity.objective: Perfect pronunciation of difficult consonant clusters and friction sounds.
consonantClarity.tip: PRO TIP: Keep your tongue tip gently between your teeth for the /θ/ ('th') sound.

pitchPatternMatch.title: Musical Melody
pitchPatternMatch.objective: Replicate the musical timing and pitch contour of the full sentence.
pitchPatternMatch.tip: PRO TIP: Match the speed transitions—unstressed words are fast, stressed are slow.

speedVariance.title: Tempo Trainer
speedVariance.objective: Speak the passage at fast, medium, and slow tempos with perfect clarity.
speedVariance.tip: PRO TIP: Keep clear boundaries between words even at high speed.

dialectDrill.title: Dialect Diver
dialectDrill.objective: Identify and mimic pronunciation variants of major global dialects.
dialectDrill.tip: PRO TIP: Pay attention to 'r' dropping and distinct vowel shifts.

connectedSpeech.title: Fusion Focus
connectedSpeech.objective: Master kontractions and reductions to speak with casual native speed.
connectedSpeech.tip: PRO TIP: Reduction turns function words like 'to' or 'for' into quick sounds.

pitchModulation.title: Dynamic Range
pitchModulation.objective: Shift pitch ranges to express emotions like excitement or surprise.
pitchModulation.tip: PRO TIP: Exaggerate pitch height for surprise, and lower it for calm authority.

branchingDialogue.title: Choice Navigator
branchingDialogue.objective: Make conversational choices that lead to a successful scenario outcome.
branchingDialogue.tip: PRO TIP: Gauge the speaker's reaction and select the most empathetic reply.

situationalResponse.title: Reflex Responder
situationalResponse.objective: Choose the most appropriate and polite social response for the scenario.
situationalResponse.tip: PRO TIP: Use expressions like 'I would appreciate it' or 'Would you mind'!

jobInterview.title: Career Closer
jobInterview.objective: Choose professional responses to nail your high-stakes job interview.
jobInterview.tip: PRO TIP: Frame replies to show how your experience solves their business needs.

medicalConsult.title: Health Liaison
medicalConsult.objective: Clearly explain symptoms or follow a doctor's detailed instructions.
medicalConsult.tip: PRO TIP: Use specific descriptors like 'throbbing', 'sharp', or 'dull ache'.

gourmetOrder.title: Order Master
gourmetOrder.objective: Order food, request custom adjustments, and settle restaurant bills.
gourmetOrder.tip: PRO TIP: Using 'Could I get...' is the preferred way to place polite orders.

travelDesk.title: Global Traveler
travelDesk.objective: Manage check-ins, navigate directions, and handle hotel booking requests.
travelDesk.tip: PRO TIP: Confirm directions by repeating them back to check understanding.

conflictResolver.title: Peace Maker
conflictResolver.objective: Resolve conversational arguments and misunderstandings using tactful words.
conflictResolver.tip: PRO TIP: De-escalate early by validating their perspective before replying.

elevatorPitch.title: Pitch Perfect
elevatorPitch.objective: Deliver a compelling, high-impact business message in 30 seconds.
elevatorPitch.tip: PRO TIP: Lead with a massive hook that frames a relatable daily problem.

socialSpark.title: Charisma Core
socialSpark.objective: Initiate and sustain engaging small talk with new acquaintances.
socialSpark.tip: PRO TIP: Ask 'what' or 'how' to keep the conversational partner sharing.

emergencyHub.title: Emergency Voice
emergencyHub.objective: Communicate clearly and stay calm under pressure in crisis scenarios.
emergencyHub.tip: PRO TIP: Clear, slow, and specific directions save lives in critical moments.

repeatSentence.title: Echo Master
repeatSentence.objective: Listen carefully and repeat the sentence matching cadence and wave patterns.
repeatSentence.tip: PRO TIP: Match the stress rhythm—English flows in stressed clusters!

pronunciationFocus.title: Phonetic Precision
pronunciationFocus.objective: Perfect mouth movements to pronounce challenging sounds and clusters.
pronunciationFocus.tip: PRO TIP: Pay attention to where your tongue touches the roof of your mouth.

dailyExpression.title: Social Fluent
dailyExpression.objective: Speak daily expressions with natural, native-like emphasis.
dailyExpression.tip: PRO TIP: Emphasize the keywords that carry the main emotional meaning.

dialogueRoleplay.title: Scene Architect
dialogueRoleplay.objective: Speak your roleplay script lines with correct emotion and phrasing.
dialogueRoleplay.tip: PRO TIP: Match your voice acting to the simulated character's mood!

sceneDescriptionSpeaking.title: Visual Narrator
sceneDescriptionSpeaking.objective: Describe the image scene clearly using descriptive adjectives.
sceneDescriptionSpeaking.tip: PRO TIP: Start with foreground actions, then move to background details.

situationSpeaking.title: Crisis Communicator
situationSpeaking.objective: Orally provide a clear, direct solution to the real-world scenario.
situationSpeaking.tip: PRO TIP: Focus on direct, simple language to convey your message quickly.

speakMissingWord.title: Vocal Decoder
speakMissingWord.objective: Read the prompt and speak the missing word clearly to fill the blank.
speakMissingWord.tip: PRO TIP: Look at surrounding nouns and verbs to match singular vs plural context.

speakOpposite.title: Antonym Orator
speakOpposite.objective: Orally state the direct opposite/antonym of the prompt word.
speakOpposite.tip: PRO TIP: Think of contrasting poles (e.g. fast/slow, build/destroy).

speakSynonym.title: Lexical Speaker
speakSynonym.objective: Orally state a correct synonym for the target word.
speakSynonym.tip: PRO TIP: Expand your vocabulary by grouping similar words together.

yesNoSpeaking.title: Voice Validator
yesNoSpeaking.objective: Answer the factual questions firmly with a spoken 'Yes' or 'No'.
yesNoSpeaking.tip: PRO TIP: Speak with confident, clear pronunciation directly into the mic.

speaking.title: Voice Mastery
speaking.objective: Tap mic and repeat the phrase clearly at a natural pace.
speaking.tip: PRO TIP: Record yourself! Comparing your pitch to the model helps master the natural rhythm.

listening.title: Audio Analysis
listening.objective: Listen carefully and choose the correct answer option.
listening.tip: PRO TIP: Close your eyes! Focusing on pure sound helps catch subtle phoneme changes.

reading.title: Text Comprehension
reading.objective: Read the passage carefully and answer the comprehension questions.
reading.tip: PRO TIP: Scan for keywords first! Don't get stuck on one word; focus on the overall message.

writing.title: Sentence Construction
writing.objective: Arrange the words in the correct order to build a complete sentence.
writing.tip: PRO TIP: Start with the verb! Finding the action helps the rest of the sentence fall into place.

grammar.title: Structural Logic
grammar.objective: Fix the underlying structural errors to complete the sentence.
grammar.tip: PRO TIP: Read the sentence out loud in your head! Often, you can 'hear' if a rule is being broken.

vocabulary.title: Word Power
vocabulary.objective: Match words to their correct definitions to expand your vocabulary.
vocabulary.tip: PRO TIP: Visual associations help! Try to link the word to a picture in your mind.

accent.title: Phonetic Drill
accent.objective: Focus on rhythm and pitch. Sound exactly like a native speaker.
accent.tip: PRO TIP: Over-enunciate! Emphasizing the vowels helps clear up minimal pair confusion.

roleplay.title: Social Simulation
roleplay.objective: Navigate social scenarios by selecting the best conversational response.
roleplay.tip: PRO TIP: Be expressive! The tone is just as important as the words in social interactions.
